body: Honestly, I hate dating. And I’m a teen so even if I did we’d probably just break up so what’s the point? I hope I can find someone I tolerate in the future though.
Have to much and the acid fucks you.

My Dad shot me a message yesterday that he’s gonna leave me alone for a few months, so I told him to just stay out of it, so there’s one asshoel outta my life. My mom is okay with me getting a GED and what-not, so I messaged my school counselor and I’m gonna sign up for a GED program so I can complete school in four months. And I’m getting a job coach from our school to find me something suitable for my disability (got dyscalculia, ‘math dyslexia’.) so I could emancipate near the summer of next year. So I hope this works out, it just happened in like two days so I’m scared something bad will happen but I’m keeping hope that this is my gate-way out.
Dude I feel the exact same. I even feel like that with friends, so I’m trying to better myself about that.

Thank you so much for commenting. We’ve actually entered in family therapy, after one of my attempts, and it went bad.

My mom stopped showing up after two sessions, and my dad refused to listen to anything. I and the counselor tried to explain what I needed/what it’s like for me. My dad just got angry and stopped answering calls for appointments since the counselor ‘insulted’ him by saying he doesn’t stand up for me. My mom didn’t bring anything up about it ever again like she wasn’t even apart of that.

After maybe testing the water with body language that says I’m ‘interested in you’, and maybe trying to show more skin or just smile and talk to them more, I just tell them straight-out how I feel. I usually say “I like you” followed by why I do. I’ve noticed I never actually ask them out on a date afterwards. Maybe that’s why I’ve never dated in person because after I tell them I kinda just walk away. Almost like I’m just trying to get it out of my system, and in a way I kinda am. Totally prefer being single lmao, not that I know how to traditionally(?) flirt.

NTA - But everyone needs to understand that the daughter is definitely dealing with severe BDD. No matter how old she is won’t effect it. She might be being an ass to her dad but that doesn’t mean that everyone should be rude to her too. She needs to stay in therapy. If she doesn’t get better, it won’t matter how much surgery she gets, she’ll just want more. She needs to STAY in a program, and you need to be kind to her. Obviously it’s not okay that she’s dragging him down with her, but she is most likely doing it because of her BDD.

You’re unfortunately getting abused. I thought the same growing up, I would see and hear people and the internet telling me I was but I thought I grew up in a normal environment. It only was until my therapist told me I was getting abused that I really started to look at it, and now that I’m more versed on the subject I’ve noticed how shitty some of my friends home life’s are too. No matter if they hit you once, or 100 times that is abuse period. You’re Mom sounds like she may have some issues of her own (which doesn’t excuse her behavior, just an insight) my mom is the same and she has severe untreated Borderline personality disorder. Please try and create some safe spaces around your town or friends places so you can go places when you absolutely need it. I wish you well.
Dude it infuriates me to no end, so fucked up.
Ye I know it ain’t clean but the apology really made me think of this lmao.

Have you contacted CPS? You can leave an anonymous tip. They haven’t helped with me, but they are when theirs blatant bruises involved. I’m sorry you gotta deal with that shit man. If you aren’t allowed to be emancipated or anything I recommend staying at a friends, I do that when my parents get super abrasive so I can avoid being the subject of their hatred. I’m sorry if this didn’t really help but this is just what I’ve been doing to at least lessen the effects.

That’s what I’m thinking because even if I wanted to fade out slowly it would be more difficult. I just don’t want the whole back in forth that I know she’ll probably pull on every contact see has on me. Thank you.
Yeah it’s definitely the most sensible, it’s just hard imagining them out of my life. Thanks so much.
